name: One Click SEO Optimizer – AI SEO, Audit, Schema & WooCommerce SEO
author: Loopus

sections.description:
AI SEO Assistant For WordPress And WooCommerce

One Click SEO Optimizer helps you finish SEO work faster inside WordPress.

Generate SEO titles, meta descriptions, H1 suggestions, content ideas, internal linking suggestions, social metadata and schema recommendations with AI. Review the results and apply them from your WordPress dashboard, Gutenberg, Classic Editor or Elementor.

This is not just an AI meta tag generator. It also includes a SEO Health Score, quick wins, XML sitemaps, schema markup, Open Graph fields, Twitter Cards, 404 monitoring, redirects, technical SEO audits, Google Search Console analytics, bulk optimization, WooCommerce SEO and multilingual SEO tools.

Use it for posts, pages, supported custom post types and WooCommerce products. It fits existing SEO workflows, including sites already using popular SEO plugins such as Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO.

Bring your own OpenAI API key. AI requests are only sent when you ask the plugin to generate or analyze SEO content.

Main Use Cases

  • Generate SEO titles and meta descriptions with AI
  • Improve H1s, objectives, target audience and content quality
  • Get SEO suggestions inside Gutenberg, Classic Editor and Elementor
  • Track SEO progress with a Health Score and quick wins dashboard
  • Generate XML sitemaps and add schema markup
  • Manage Open Graph and Twitter Card metadata
  • Monitor 404 errors and create redirects
  • Run technical SEO audits
  • Connect Google Search Console analytics
  • Optimize WooCommerce products and multilingual websites

Compatibility

  • Gutenberg block editor
  • Classic Editor
  • Elementor
  • WooCommerce
  • Supported custom post types
  • WPML and Polylang in Pro
  • Existing SEO plugin workflows, including Yoast SEO, Rank Math and All in One SEO

If another SEO plugin already outputs front-end titles, descriptions or social tags, review your settings to avoid duplicate metadata.

Free Features

AI SEO Generation

  • SEO title and meta description generation
  • H1, keyword, objective and target audience suggestions
  • Content improvement and internal linking suggestions
  • Readability and content scoring
  • SEO language setting with auto-detection or manual override
  • Support for 17+ common languages plus installed WordPress languages
  • OpenAI model selection with GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4 mini, GPT-5.2, GPT-5 mini and GPT-5 nano

Dashboard And Workflow

  • SEO Health Score from 0 to 100
  • Optimization coverage and configuration tracking
  • Quick wins dashboard
  • Recent optimization activity
  • Guided onboarding wizard
  • Site presets for common website types

Technical SEO

  • XML sitemap generation
  • Google and Bing sitemap notification
  • Schema markup with automatic detection
  • Open Graph metadata fields
  • Twitter Card metadata fields

Editor Support

  • Elementor SEO panel
  • Gutenberg-compatible analysis and scoring
  • Classic Editor meta box
  • One-click optimization for posts, pages and supported custom post types

Pro Features

Technical SEO Audit

  • Full SEO audit with 47+ checks
  • Checks meta tags, images, links, content, indexation, performance and security
  • Audit one page, selected pages or the full site
  • Incremental re-audit without wiping unrelated results
  • Batch processing and CSV export

Redirections And 404 Monitoring

  • Automatic 404 logging
  • Redirect manager for 301, 302 and 307 redirects
  • Redirect suggestions from detected 404 URLs
  • One-click redirect creation
  • CSV import and export

Google Search Console Analytics

  • OAuth connection to Google Search Console
  • KPIs for clicks, impressions, CTR and average position
  • Top pages and top queries reports

WooCommerce And Multilingual SEO

  • WooCommerce product SEO support
  • Product schema and product Open Graph metadata
  • Product brand, GTIN and MPN fields
  • Bulk product optimization
  • WPML and Polylang support
  • Hreflang tags and multilingual sitemap support

Bulk Optimization

  • Bulk SEO optimization from the posts list screen
  • Live progress modal
  • Cancellation support

External Services

This plugin connects to external services only when related features are configured or triggered by the site owner.

OpenAI API

  • Purpose: generate AI-powered SEO recommendations, metadata and content analysis
  • Data sent: page title, page content, excerpt, selected SEO fields and site context
  • Trigger: only when you request AI optimization or analysis
  • Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
  • Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

Google Search Console API

  • Purpose: fetch search performance analytics and property data
  • Data sent: OAuth flow data and Search Console query requests
  • Trigger: only when a Pro user connects Google Search Console
  • Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google And Bing Sitemap Notification Endpoints

  • Purpose: notify search engines when the sitemap is generated or refreshed
  • Data sent: sitemap URL
  • Trigger: when sitemap notifications are enabled or run by the plugin workflow

Freemius Services

  • Purpose: licensing, Pro account, premium updates and support workflows
  • Data sent: license key, site URL, plugin version and account details when you opt in or activate Pro
  • Trigger: account connection, license activation or Pro workflow
  • Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/
  • Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

Privacy Policy

One Click SEO Optimizer may process the following data when features are used:

  • Page content, titles, excerpts and SEO fields for AI analysis
  • Sitemap URLs for search engine notifications
  • Search Console tokens and analytics responses when connected

The plugin does not send personal data to external services unless it is part of the content you choose to analyze or a service you connect. All remote requests use HTTPS.

Support

  • Website: https://oneclickseo.loopus.tech/
  • Support: WordPress support forum
  • Pro: priority support
sections.installation:
1. Install One Click SEO Optimizer from the WordPress plugin directory or upload it to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open OneClick SEO in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your OpenAI API key.
  5. Choose your AI model, language and content types.
  6. Run the onboarding wizard.
  7. Open a post, page or product and generate your first SEO suggestions.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Yes. One Click SEO Optimizer uses your own OpenAI API key. AI requests are only sent when you trigger an AI feature.

Which OpenAI models can I use?

You can choose GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4 mini, GPT-5.2, GPT-5 mini or GPT-5 nano from the plugin settings.

Does it replace Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO?

Not necessarily. You can use it as an AI optimization, audit and workflow layer alongside an existing SEO setup. If another plugin already outputs front-end titles, descriptions or social tags, review your settings to avoid duplicate metadata.

Is it only an AI meta tag generator?

No. It also includes scoring, content suggestions, schema, sitemaps, editor integrations, 404 monitoring, redirects, audits, Search Console analytics, WooCommerce SEO, multilingual SEO and bulk optimization.

Which editors are supported?

Gutenberg, Classic Editor and Elementor are supported.

Does it support WooCommerce?

Yes. Pro includes product SEO, product schema, Open Graph metadata, brand fields, GTIN, MPN and bulk product optimization.

Does it support multilingual sites?

Yes. Pro includes WPML and Polylang support, hreflang handling, multilingual sitemap support and per-page language detection for AI generation.

Can I audit only selected pages?

Yes. Pro includes selective audit for one page, multiple pages or the full site.

Does the plugin automatically send my content to external services?

No. Page content is sent to OpenAI only when you request AI optimization or analysis. Search Console data is fetched only after you connect Google Search Console in Pro.

What PHP version is required?

PHP 7.4 or higher.

Where can I get help?

Use the WordPress support forum or visit https://oneclickseo.loopus.tech/. Pro users receive priority support.
